cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
새벽 나락 풀퀘팟 맞죠?
물퀘랑 윈저 호위퀘까지
전부 다 깨고 가는 거!
cuts.visual_prompt: 3-to-3.5 head-tall sleek Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Medium three-quarter angle with the Skyborn mage on the left and the Gnome rogue on the right standing on a minimal dark dwarven stone floor shadow. The mage gestures cheerfully with one open hand while holding her mage staff in the other, wearing an eager confident smile. The rogue stands stiffly with daggers sheathed at her waist, staring ahead with an unreadable blank deadpan expression.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
한 시간 돌았는데 호위퀘까지?
파장도 채팅 한 줄 안 치네.
난 못 해, 먼저 빠진다~
cuts.visual_prompt: 3-to-3.5 head-tall sleek Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Wide horizontal shot showing the Dwarf hunter on the left turning away to leave with her blunderbuss gun strapped securely on her back, casually holding up a glowing cyan Hearthstone in one hand with a carefree grin. On the right, the Tauren druid clutches her gnarled wooden staff and reaches out in sheer panic with wide watery eyes and sweat drops, standing on minimal dark stone ground shadow. Beside Dwarf Hunter, her ultra-cute chubby round baby brown bear cub wearing a forest-green neckerchief waves a carefree goodbye paw.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
파장님! 냥꾼도 가고
퀘는 하나도 못 깼어요!
다시 구해요, 접어요?
cuts.visual_prompt: 3-to-3.5 head-tall sleek Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Over-the-shoulder angle from behind the Skyborn mage on the left foreground looking toward the Gnome rogue on the right midground. The mage leans forward urgently with her staff slung on her back and both empty hands raised in exasperation. The rogue remains completely motionless with daggers sheathed at her waist and a blank glassy stare.

cuts.speaker: 노움 도적
cuts.visual_prompt: 3-to-3.5 head-tall sleek Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Slight low-angle dramatic zoom-in on the Gnome rogue centered in the frame with a minimal floor shadow beneath her boots. Her daggers stay sheathed at her waist as she deadpans calmly with tiny blank eyes and raises one hand holding a small grey smoke pellet, beginning to pop a puffy cloud of Vanish stealth smoke around her feet.

3-to-3.5 head-tall sleek Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Silent freeze-frame waist-up reaction shot of the Skyborn mage on the left and the Tauren druid on the right with their weapons strapped on their backs and empty arms dropped stiffly at their sides. Both girls stare straight ahead in absolute deadpan disbelief with pinpoint dot eyes and gaping mouths as a faint leftover puff of grey stealth smoke drifts across the foreground.

cuts.speaker: 스카이본 마법사
cuts.dialogue:
한국인이잖아, 뭔 예스야!!
퀘 다 날리고 파티 터졌네!
저 도적 당장 선차단 박아!
cuts.visual_prompt: 3-to-3.5 head-tall sleek Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Dynamic slightly tilted high-angle wide shot on a minimal dark stone floor shadow. On the left, the Skyborn mage with her staff strapped on her back points furiously at the empty spot where the rogue vanished, shouting in pure outrage with wild eyes. On the right, the Tauren druid sits slumped in defeat with her wooden staff lying beside her, burying her face in her hands and crying comically.
